digest.component_or_area: plan review gate calibration (E3 measurement harness)
propositions: Deterministic replay infrastructure (stratified sample, frozen baseline, FP-control pool, driver seams, metrics library, golden tests) was designed and built as WIP on branch calib/6982-e3 and is intentionally not landed on main.

The ~450-run live LLM batch replay is permanently rejected on cost grounds; the verdict-perturbation signal it would measure is now superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder operating at $0 marginal LLM cost on production reviews.

The replay driver eliminates two confounds via recall-stripped clone (copy store, delete REVIEW_RESULT.json), material-fingerprint drift guard, and two-tier structure (coarse ~200 sweep plus precise 30-plan FP-control with fresh candidate and current gate runs).

History-based baseline mining is infeasible due to impact_model_version bump stranding sidecar history to ~4 rows versus ~200 needed, making live replay the only viable approach and justifying batch deferral.
The e3_metrics library provides pure LLM-free analysis functions (criterion_deltas, tkey, build_matrix, pass_to_block_flip_rate, fp_control_eval, fp_control_valid) with golden test coverage.
